import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { evalManifest } from "next/dist/server/load-manifest.external";

import { authorize } from "@/src/boundary/authorize";
import { denialResponse } from "@/src/boundary/denial";

export function proxy(request: NextRequest): Response {
  const target = request.headers.get("x-target");
  if (target !== null) {
    evalManifest(target, false);
  }
  return denialResponse(authorize(), request.method);
}
